title: Jachʼa jachʼa tukuñ Uraqin jan istʼat jawsäwi
intro: Mä kutix jach’a civilización ukan t’unjäwipan sayt’atätawa, kawkhantix ch’amampi jach’a jach’a tukuñampix janiw tukuskir yatipkänti. Mä yatiyirix jupanak taypin sarnaqäna, chiqa yatichäwir jawsasa, ukampis chuymanakapax qala chuymanïxänwa. Uka ewjjtʼajj janiw istʼaskänti, alajjpachajj colerasiñatak mä instrumentoruw tukuwayjjäna. ¿Khitis uka yatiyirixa, ukat jawsatäñ jan iyawsirinakax kunas pasapxäna?
clues: Mä markar khitapxitäna, jupanakax ch’amanïpxänwa, jupanakax sapa jach’a chiqanakanwa mä monumento lurapxäna.
Markajajj jan atipjatäkaspas ukhamwa amuyasipjjäna, ukat akham sapjjäna: ‘¿Khitis chʼamanïñasajj jiwasat sipansa jukʼamp chʼamani?’ sasa.
Nayax jupanakarux Allah saparukiw yupaychapxañapatak jawst’awayta, ukampis jupanakax jan amuyt’asirïta ukat k’arisiñat juchañchapxitu.
Chiqpachansa arsuwaykta uka castigo apaniñajatakiw chʼamañchtʼapxitäna.
Allah jupanakarux mä jan ch’uxña thaya khithatayna, ukax janiw kuns qhispiykänti.
Nayampi khitinakatix nayamp chika iyawsapkän ukanakax Allahan khuyapayasiñapampiw qhispiyatäpxta, jan iyawsirinakax q’al t’unjatäpxänwa.

trial.answer: Mä jan waltʼayir thayajj jan iyawsirinakaruw tʼunjäna

outcome.answer: Hud ukat iyawsirinakasti qhispiyatäpxänwa, jan iyawsirinakas t'unjatäpxarakïnwa

arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ۖ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verse: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers. (7:72)
